checkpoint: collapsible panes, SGR mouse gestures and source-ordered article annotations

environment.build: release, thin LTO, one codegen unit
environment.cargo_sources: 41 temporary upstream source substitutions; unchanged 266-package version/dependency graph; restored registry lock removes stale unused-patch metadata without changing selected packages
environment.renderer: Ratatui TestBackend; separate optimized SGR PTY smoke
environment.control: Three fresh processes per size; shared-host scheduling and caches uncontrolled

correctness: Each timed interaction checks saved dimensions, exact readable/clipboard bytes or source-order annotation identity and jump paragraph. Fixture generation, event allocation/cloning and initial syntax completion are outside operation timers.
limitations: No speedup claim: this is a new workload without a comparable pre-feature baseline.
Timers include application dispatch, reflow/poll and TestBackend frame, excluding physical terminal paint and key/mouse transport.
Separate PTY smoke verifies actual SGR parsing and terminal cleanup, not physical Alacritty input latency.
Whole-process wall and RSS include setup; RSS is not an allocation count.
Verification used temporary upstream source substitutions. Clean registry builds and connected advisory/distribution audits remain unqualified.
